sents.t: On a cold morning in March, Rosa was walking Max when she slipped on some ice in front of our building.
I was leaving for work when I heard her shout.
She was sitting on the ground and holding her wrist.
I called Danny, but he was at work, so I called a taxi.
At the emergency room at Oakville Hospital, a nurse asked Rosa for her name, her date of birth, and her insurance card.
Finally, a doctor saw her, and Ana was working that day!
She smiled and held Rosa’s hand while the doctor looked at the X-ray.
“Your wrist is broken,” the doctor said.
“You’ll need a cast for six weeks.”
“If I have to wear it, it should be pretty,” she joked.
For the next six weeks, Rosa couldn’t cook or carry heavy things, so we all helped her.
I walked Max every morning and every evening, and Emma did her grocery shopping.
“I have the best neighbors in the world.”
